function.name: state_update
function.description: Update session defaults (charge, multiplicity, method, basis, solvent, current_geom, etc.) in a uniform way.

function.name: state_get_tool_args
function.description: Fetch all arguments needed for a specific MCP tool using current session state (injects geometry_xyz and defaults).

overrides.description: Optional explicit overrides to apply on top of state defaults.

function.name: name_to_geometry_xyz
function.description: Resolve a chemical name to an initial 3D geometry (XYZ without natoms/comment). Uses web services (OPSIN/PubChem) and converts SDF->XYZ. Stores provenance in result.

name.description: Chemical name, e.g. acetone, methanol, caffeine.

function.name: build_dimer_xyz
function.description: Assemble two molecules into a dimer starting geometry for an interaction-energy scan. Centers molecule A at its centroid, then places molecule B along the chosen axis so that B's reference atom (ref_atom_b) is at distance_ang from A's centroid. Returns geometry_xyz, n_atoms_a, n_atoms_b, offset_b (=n_atoms_a), and scan_atom_b (0-based index of ref_atom_b in the combined geometry). Use output_id to route the assembled geometry to run_scan_job.

geom_a_id.description: Geometry key for molecule A (host / larger molecule, e.g. benzene).

geom_b_id.description: Geometry key for molecule B (guest / approaching molecule, e.g. NO2+).

distance_ang.description: Initial distance in Angstrom between centroid of A and ref_atom_b of B (default 3.5).

ref_atom_b.description: 0-based atom index in B to use as the approach reference — typically the atom closest to A (e.g. N of NO2+, O of H2O). Default 0.

output_id.description: Geometry key under which the assembled dimer is stored in state.

function.name: build_approach_scan_geometries
function.description: Generate N dimer geometries by rigidly translating mol_b toward mol_a along the centroid-to-centroid vector. Step 0 is mol_b at its current position; step i shifts mol_b by step_ang*i Å closer. Stores each dimer as {output_prefix}_{i:02d} in state. Follow immediately with parallel run_sp_energy nodes on each geom_id. Use this for rigid-body approach scans — no ORCA constraints needed, works for any fragment size and orientation. The planner knows the geom_ids at plan time since they are {output_prefix}_{00..n_steps-1}.

mol_a_id.description: Geometry key for the fixed molecule (host, e.g. 'benzene'). Also accepted as host_geom_id or geom_a_id.

mol_b_id.description: Geometry key for the moving molecule (guest, e.g. 'no2plus'). Its current position in state sets the starting geometry — use set_geometry_xyz or build_dimer_xyz first to place it correctly. Also accepted as guest_geom_id or geom_b_id.

n_steps.description: Number of dimer geometries to generate. Step 0 = starting position.

step_ang.description: Step size in Angstrom per step. mol_b moves this far toward mol_a at each step.

output_prefix.description: Prefix for generated geometry IDs. Geom IDs will be {output_prefix}_00, _01, ... Default: '{mol_a_id}_{mol_b_id}_approach'.

ref_atom_a.description: 0-based atom index in mol_a to aim toward (default: centroid of mol_a). Use this to target a specific atom, e.g. ref_atom_a=0 to aim mol_b directly toward atom 0 of mol_a, giving a straight-line approach to that atom.

function.name: set_geometry_xyz
function.description: Store a literal XYZ coordinate block directly into the geometry registry. Use this when the planner computes a custom dimer geometry (tilted approach, off-centre target atom, EAS starting geometry, etc.) and needs to inject it into state. The planner writes the coordinates explicitly in its chain-of-thought, then passes them here. No natoms/comment header — raw 'El x y z' lines only.

geom_id.description: Key under which to store the geometry in state (e.g. 'dimer', 'eas_start').

geometry_xyz.description: Raw coordinate block, no header. One 'El  x  y  z' line per atom, newline-separated.

function.name: build_coordination_complex
function.description: Build a 3D coordination complex geometry using molSimplify (server-side). Returns geometry_xyz for use with output_id → run_opt_job. Coordination number is derived automatically from ligand denticities (e.g. 3×en = CN 6). Spin is auto-determined for common cases: d10→1, Cu(II)→2, d8 sqp→1, d8 thd→3, Fe/Co/Cr/Mn→ANN. Omit spin unless overriding.

ligands.description: molSimplify ligand names, one entry per ligand (bidentate like en/bipy count as 2 sites automatically). Common: 'cl','water','nh3','co','cn','en','bipy','acac','acetate','ox','ncs'. Repeat for multiple identical ligands.

geometry.description: oct=octahedral(6), sqp=square planar(4), tbp=trigonal bipyramidal(5), thd=tetrahedral(4).

spin.description: Spin multiplicity 2S+1. Omit for auto-determination: d10→1, d9→2, d8 sqp→1, d8 thd→3, d3 oct→4. For Fe/Co/Cr/Mn oct: strong-field ligands (CN,CO,en,bipy,NH3)→low spin, weak-field (Cl,H2O,NCS,OAc)→high spin. Provide explicitly for Ru, Ir, Rh, or to override.

charge.description: Total complex charge (metal ox + sum of ligand charges).

function.name: run_opt_job
function.description: Optimize geometry with ORCA. Supports optional geometry constraints (fix bonds, angles, dihedrals) for constrained optimization.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

type.description: B=bond (2 atoms), A=angle (3 atoms), D=dihedral (4 atoms)

atoms.description: 0-based atom indices in the dimer geometry

value.description: Target distance (Å for B) or angle (° for A/D). Omit to fix at the current geometry value.

constraints.description: Optional constraints. Example: [{"type":"B","atoms":[0,14]}] freezes the bond between atoms 0 and 14 at its current distance. Atom indices in merged dimer: mol_a atoms first (0..N_a-1), then mol_b atoms (N_a..N_a+N_b-1).

xtb_preopt.description: Run a cheap GFN2-xTB pre-optimisation before the DFT opt. Use in on_error patch when RESOURCE_LIMIT is triggered — starts B3LYP from a better geometry so it converges in fewer cycles.

function.name: run_nbo_job
function.description: Run an ORCA NBO/NPA calculation.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

function.name: run_sp_energy
function.description: Run a single-point DFT job. Always returns energy_eh, dipole_moment_debye, homo_lumo_gap_ev. Add extra properties via the 'properties' list: 'nbo' (NBO/NPA analysis → nbo_section), 'tddft' (TD-DFT excited states → excited_states). These map directly to ORCA input blocks in a single job.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

properties.description: Extra properties to compute in the same ORCA run. 'nbo' adds NBO keyword; 'tddft' adds %tddft block. 'dipole' and 'homo_lumo_gap' are always returned and need not be listed.

n_tddft_states.description: Number of TD-DFT roots (only used when 'tddft' is in properties).

function.name: run_freq_job
function.description: Run an ORCA frequency calculation. Returns electronic energy E, enthalpy H, and Gibbs free energy G (all in Eh). Use after geometry optimization to obtain thermodynamic properties.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

function.name: run_spectrum_job
function.description: Run an ORCA frequency + vibrational spectrum calculation. Returns the same E/H/G as run_freq_job PLUS ir_spectrum (list of {mode, freq_cm1, intensity_km_mol}) and optionally raman_spectrum (list of {mode, freq_cm1, activity, depolarization}). Use on an already-optimised geometry.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

spectrum_type.description: ir = IR only; raman / ir_raman = IR + Raman (adds %elprop Polar 1, roughly 2x cost).

function.name: run_tddft_job
function.description: Run an ORCA TD-DFT excited-state calculation on an already-optimised geometry. Returns energy_ground_state_eh, homo_lumo_gap_ev (KS orbital gap in eV), and excited_states list with energy_ev, wavelength_nm, oscillator_strength per state. Use run_opt_job first.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

nroots.description: Number of excited singlet states to compute (default 5; increase for broader spectral coverage).

function.name: run_scan_job
function.description: Run a rigid ORCA surface scan: vary one or more internal coordinates (bond/angle/dihedral) and compute SP energy at each point. Returns scan_results list with {step, value, energy_eh} for every geometry, plus min_energy_eh and min_value.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id of the starting geometry.

scan_coords.description: JSON array of scan coordinate dicts. Each dict: {"type":"B"|"A"|"D", "atoms":[i,j,...], "start":float, "end":float, "n_points":int}. type: B=bond(Å), A=angle(deg), D=dihedral(deg). atoms: 0-based ORCA indices (2 for B, 3 for A, 4 for D). Example: '[{"type":"B","atoms":[0,1],"start":0.8,"end":1.8,"n_points":11}]'

function.name: run_ts_opt_job
function.description: Run an ORCA transition-state optimisation (OptTS) on a geometry near the TS (e.g., the PES maximum from run_scan_job). calc_hess=true (default) adds Calc_Hess true, strongly recommended for reliable TS searches. Returns geometry_xyz (optimised TS structure), energy_eh, and ts_converged.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id of the TS candidate geometry (e.g., PES maximum from run_scan_job).

calc_hess.description: Add Calc_Hess true to %geom block. Required for reliable OptTS; set false only if Hessian already provided.

function.name: run_solvator_cluster
function.description: Build an explicit-solvent cluster (water) around a solute using ORCA SOLVATOR. Returns cluster geometry only (no thermochemistry). Use run_freq_job on the output cluster to get E/H/G.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

nsolv.description: Number of water molecules to add around the solute.

job_label.description: Optional label. If omitted, the server will generate one.

function.name: run_solvator_cluster_thermo
function.description: Combined tool: build microsolvated cluster with SOLVATOR then run ORCA frequency for E/H/G. Prefer using run_solvator_cluster + run_freq_job separately for more control.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

nsolv.description: Number of water molecules to add around the solute.

wall_timeout_seconds.description: Soft wall-clock timeout hint; host may ignore.

job_label.description: Optional label for this SOLVATOR job. If omitted, the server will generate one.

function.name: structure_add_remove_proton
function.description: Add or remove one proton (H) from a geometry. Geometry, charge and multiplicity are read from the GeometryRegistry via input_geom_id (do NOT specify them). The tool auto-selects the site by default. Returns edited XYZ with updated charge.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

h_index.description: Optional: index of H to remove (auto-detected if omitted).

target_atom_index.description: Optional: index of atom to protonate (auto-detected if omitted).

function.name: run_casscf_job
function.description: Run a CASSCF single-point calculation with ORCA. Requires specifying the active space: nel (number of active electrons) and norb (number of active orbitals). Set nroots > 1 for state-averaged SA-CASSCF over multiple roots. Returns energy_eh (total or SA-average energy) and energies_eh list when nroots > 1. Use after geometry optimization.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

nel.description: Number of active electrons in the CAS active space, e.g. 5 for Fe(III) d5.

norb.description: Number of active orbitals in the CAS active space, e.g. 5 for Fe d-orbitals.

nroots.description: Number of roots for state-averaged SA-CASSCF (default 1 = single-state CASSCF).

function.name: geom_update
function.description: Update geometry metadata/electronic state (rename, add alias, set charge/multiplicity) and optionally set it as current.

ref.description: Geometry id or alias/name. If omitted, uses current.

set_current.description: If true, set this geometry as current.
